templates.purpose: One new S1 incident, told at once to the operator; also the notice of an incident opened by the silent-source check.

variables.severity_tag: string — S1 (the alert is S1 only; S2 goes in a batch)
variables.severity_label: string — severity as shape and word, e.g. "◆ S1 critical"
variables.title: string — the incident's own title (never event content, IP or user agent)
variables.source: string — the source's name or the check that opened the incident
variables.sla_due_at: string — UTC acknowledge-by time; empty when the incident has no SLA deadline
variables.incident_url: string — link to the incident in the ventSec admin

templates.purpose: An S1 incident still not acknowledged after the escalation time, sent once more.

variables.severity_label: string — severity as shape and word, e.g. "◆ S1 critical"
variables.title: string — the incident's own title
variables.source: string — the source's name or the check that opened the incident
variables.sla_due_at: string — UTC acknowledge-by time; empty when the incident has no SLA deadline
variables.incident_url: string — link to the incident in the ventSec admin
variables.escalation_minutes: int — minutes since the first alert (15 by default)

templates.purpose: Two or more open S2 incidents, told in one mail when the batch window (at most 15 minutes) ends.

variables.count: int — number of incidents in the mail (two or more)
variables.incidents_lines: string — multi-line list, one block per incident: severity label, number, title, source, then its link; blocks separated by a blank line (render in a white-space:pre-wrap block)

templates.purpose: The daily digest of open S3/S4 incidents nobody was told about yet.

variables.count: int — number of open S3/S4 incidents in the digest
variables.incidents_lines: string — multi-line list, one block per incident (severity label, number, title, source, link), sorted by severity then number; blocks separated by a blank line (render in a white-space:pre-wrap block)

subject.hu: ventSec összefoglaló: {{ count }} nyitott S3/S4 incidens
subject.en: ventSec digest: {{ count }} open S3/S4 incident(s)

templates.purpose: A source went silent and the check opened no incident to announce (an opened incident goes out as incident-alert).

variables.app: string — the silent source's app, e.g. ventsso
variables.silent_seconds: int — seconds since its last event or heartbeat

subject.hu: ventSec: a(z) {{ app }} ({{ env }}) forrás {{ silent_seconds }} mp óta néma
subject.en: ventSec: source {{ app }} ({{ env }}) has been silent for {{ silent_seconds }} s
